items.title: Isaiah Morgan Interview, 1958-12-01
items.q: Well, he played with me. He used to make all the trips with me.

ctx.x: Well, I think we're taking Alfred Williams, Sam's old drummer. He's still living here. He's here now. Yes, I know. Well, he played with me. He used to make all the trips with me. We didn't have no drummer. Well, Sean was the first drummer that we had. Then after Sean left, we'd taken Roy. Sean used to get drunk and then claim he was losing his mind. And we'd taken this boy. And he married a girl over in Mississippi. And that told him to stay with the band. And he died. And we'd taken Alfred. And just anybody…
Oh, who did you use on piano on the records?
